item.title: Family of unarmed man shot to death by Washtenaw County deputies files lawsuit
item.description: Four deputies have been placed on leave by the Washtenaw County Sheriff’s Department as Michigan State Police investigate the officer-involved shooting.

item.title: One dead in Friday night car vs. person crash in Monroe
item.description: A 41-year-old woman from Newport was killed Friday night when a car struck her on the side of Telegraph Road in Monroe Township. item.title: Woman's body found in street, wrapped in cloth and plastic, on Detroit's east side
item.description: Police on a routine patrol discovered a woman's body in the street near Palmer Park at about 6 p.m. Sunday night. The body was found near Hershey and Annin Streets, which is just a few blocks from Woodward and 7 Mile. When FOX 2 arrived at the scene, the woman's body was covered in two distinct types of cloth and had a plastic bag tied around it.The homicide unit was called to the scene to investigate.
